csharpDecisions: LlvmEmitter.Expressions.Core EmitWriteInterpolation evaluates each complete expression before writing the value.
LlvmEmitter.Expressions.Control EmitFoldExpression evaluates source and initial state, then returns the result of its selected range/array fold.
slgDecisions: Entry and ordinary region emitters explicitly dispatch IR32 to the existing emitFoldExpression; emitRegionValueRoot used by canonical interpolation omits that dispatch.
The canonical flow result resolver enumerates if/when/enum controls, but does not enumerate fold32; include its typed consuming result alongside the other control results.
privateScope: Add existing fold emitter dispatch and fold result identity; preserve shared conditional body and source retention already qualified. Original8 CSharp programs and expected outputs remain fixed.
